annot.p: first set of parts: S coro (8), A coro (6), T coro (2x; 7, 8), B coro (7), vlc (8), org (8); second set: S coro (1), A coro (1), T coro (1), B coro (1), vlne (1), org (1)

The first set of parts (by unidentified hand) comprises all movements. The second set (by Copyist Neukloster 1) only comprises a shortened version of the Credo. The back side of some parts contains various parts of unidentified works: A – vl 2 part for a Salve Regina (F major, 3/4 time, Andante); T – org part for an Estote fortes (B flat major, common time, Andante); B – org part for an aria with text Maria Gnadenthron (E major, common time, Tempo giusto); vlne – cemb or org part for an aria (E minor, 2/4 time, no tempo); org – vl 1 part for an aria, likely the same as on the B part (E major, common time, Tempo giusto).
